test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Radiant
solution:
The correct answer is Glowing. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Radiant' is 'Glowing'.
 
• Radiant: sending out light or heat.
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Dismal*: *causing or showing sadness; depressing
 
• Frowning: to show you are angry, serious, etc. by making lines appear on your forehead above your nose
 
• *Glowing*: *to produce light and/or heat*
 
• Depressing: to be sad or gloomy; lower in spirits
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.​
